caption:
A tan surface fills the upper part of the view, crossed by a narrow vertical specular streak. A white sheet of paper enters from below, its top edge rising while a curved rainbow-colored band appears on it. The streak drifts leftward across the background as the paper moves upward.

The colored band forms a shallow V near the paper's upper edge, with blue-white and yellow tones spreading downward. As the sheet rises, the band stays on the paper rather than the tan background, shifting only slightly with the framing. A thumb appears at the lower-left edge of the paper, while the top edge moves slightly upward. The vertical specular streak on the background keeps slowly drifting leftward, meeting the paper's upper boundary in later moments. The rainbow pattern brightens as more of the white surface enters view, then holds its curved shape. By the end, the paper occupies much of the lower area, the thumb still visible, and the colored band resting near its top edge.
relations: The white paper rising from below carries the rainbow-colored band, keeping it attached to the paper's surface.
The vertical specular streak on the tan background drifts leftward independently of the paper's upward motion.
A thumb at the lower-left edge holds the paper steady while its top edge rises.
The rainbow band maintains its shallow V shape near the paper's upper edge as more surface enters view.
